extra.message: Closed/Resolved Disputes Accept New Messages Because post_message Lacks Dispute-Status Gate

metadata.proof: The post_message handler performs only existence and view-authorization checks on the dispute but never inspects dispute.status. The companion upload_evidence endpoint at line 183 explicitly blocks resolved/closed disputes: 'if dispute.status in (DisputeStatus.resolved, DisputeStatus.closed): raise HTTPException(...)'. This inconsistency allows any participant (buyer, vendor, support) to continue adding messages to disputes long after they have been finally resolved or closed, undermining the dispute lifecycle model. SOURCE: any authenticated HTTP POST → SINK: DisputeMessage row insertion without dispute.status check.
